column1:
The value assigned to the target variable in a compound assignment is not used or is always replaced by a different value. The result value of the compound assignment expression itself may be still used in the enclosing expression, but it is unnecessary to assign the value to the target. A fix is offered to remove the assignment and retain just the expression.

Note that boolean compound operator always evaluates the expression. The fix may flip expression with the variable so the expression is always processed.
column2:
复合赋值中赋给目标变量的值 未被使用, 或总是被其他值替换。复合赋值表达式本身的结果值在外层表达式中可能仍会被使用, 但没有必要把值赋给目标变量。提供移除赋值、仅保留表达式的修复。

注意布尔复合运算符总会计算表达式。修复可能会交换表达式与变量的位置, 以保证表达式总被计算。

column1:
If the project's source level is greater than the maximum supported by the Annotation Processor, compilation that uses the Processor always generates an useless compiler warning. If the processor does not declare any @SupportedSourceVersion at all. derives from javax.annotation.processing.AbstractProcessor, the maximum supported version will default to 1.6, which will produce another useless warning during compilation.

It is recommended to return at least the current project's source level. For future compatibility, consider to return SourceVersion.latest(); most Processors are not affected by future language changes.
column2:
如果项目源码级别高于注解处理器所支持的最高版本, 使用该处理器的编译总会产生无用的编译警告。若处理器完全没有声明 @SupportedSourceVersion 且派生自 javax.annotation.processing.AbstractProcessor, 则最高支持版本会默认为 1.6, 编译时会产生另一个无用警告。

建议至少返回当前项目的源码级别。 为兼容未来, 可考虑返回 SourceVersion.latest(); 多数处理器不受未来语言变化影响。
